item_title: NVivo trial
item_student_note:
NVivo 12 Pro, a computer-assisted qualitative analysis software (CAQDAS) program, is an industry standard with a wide range of tutorials and resources available in both text and video formats. A 14-day trial is available for both Windows and Mac at QSR International.

Important Note: If you plan to use the 14-day free trial version, do not download it before Unit 6. You will need access to the CAQDAS software you select in Unit 6 to participate in the discussion, and in Unit 7 to perform an analysis of a sample data set and collect screen shots that illustrate the analysis process to submit with your assignment.
